rules.historical_meaning_only: An intercepted sign is another conditional source input, not universal for all charts.
Person types are selected by period planetary analogies, not actual measured human character.
Saturn is given as lord/occupant condition for associated friends.
The Saturnian friend stereotype includes older men.
Agricultural workers are separately included.
Metal traders and tradespeople are Saturn-category examples.
Stone craftsmen are another old source category.
Money lending is assigned to Saturn's source category.
The Saturnian source also includes moral condemnation, not an observed trait.
Jupiter begins a separate clerical/judicial and elite class.
Church leadership appears under Jupiter's friends list.
Legal professions are separately named as Jupiter friends.
Jupiter is also assigned wealthy/noble social positions.
Administrative rulers are another source occupational class.
The original gives supposedly virtuous personal traits, not actual identifiable people.
Mars governs a category of martial and military friends.
Military leadership/enlistment are distinct roles in the source.
Surgeons are included in Mars type, not solely military.
Pejorative or approving personality labels under Mars cannot describe actual individuals.
Physical appearance is another unsupported source stereotype.
Ordinary crafts/traders can also be Mars-related friends.
Sun category refers to authority/royal social groups.
Royal persons are separate from officials and advisors.
Court advisors are another sun-associated friend type.
Political/social power is used as generalized solar association.
Government officers are named as another solar class.
Venus covers cultural/artistic friend classes.
Music and poetry as alternative alleged friend professions.
Old retail health trade is another Venus-related friend category.
Gamblers/gaming participants are named Venus alternatives.
Visual arts and painting are separately included as Venus-associated friend categories.
Venus type explicitly includes women, a period gender category not a precise prediction.
Multiple valued/gendered personality labels are attached to the Venus source.
Mercury type covers learning, crafts and intellectual services.
Learning, chancellery and mathematics professions are alleged.
Administrative and trade work are further Mercury friend types.
A judgment of cunning/subtle nature is unverified personal attribution.
Moon type includes family and social categories rather than only trades.
Female social rank/family status are included in lunar friendships.
Diplomatic/courier roles also enter lunar friends types.
Seafaring and fishing roles are alternative Moon professions.
General ordinary social class is also assigned to Moon, an expansive category.
An alleged moral/personality defect is assigned to Moon, not actual trustworthiness.
Internal subsection changes question from friend type to persistence of relationships.
Fixed zodiac sign on eleventh cusp is given as constancy source.
The author alleges stable friendships from fixed signs, no longitudinal human measures.
Movable sign on cusp is compared against fixed rather than ignored.
The original claims changeable friends for movable signs.
Common/bicorporeal sign is a third distinct mode.
Middle source says friends of varying durability.
Lilly repeats the eleventh cusp sign as primary constancy source.
Zodiac signs containing relevant planets are additional source evidence.
